title_en: Four dead, two injured in retaliatory shooting incident at Narathiwat
summary_en: NARATHIWAT: A police officer and three men suspected of being members of the National Revolutionary Front (BRN) were killed, while two Rangers were injured in a shootout incident in Si Sakhon district, Narathiwat last morning.
